text:
maya: Quick huddle thread 1: We need to align product/eng/runtime/infra/security on the SmartServe initiative. Plan is staged pilot -> GA. Blocking items: infra prewarm, HSM validation, perf delta for quantized models. Can owners call blockers + acceptance criteria?

raj: Runtime update here. Adaptive batching + KV cache fixes needed to hit target latency under HOURLY throughput. Rough estimate 2-3 sprints if infra slots are ready. Need explicit perf targets from product.

lin: I'll handle model perf & quant profiles. Suggest running with default batch=8 for pilot, batch=4 for low-latency customers. Need both A100 and Tr4 runs. Will try to finish matrix next Tue/Wed.

olga: Infra: staging cluster available week of 2024-09-25 for a small beta pool. GA requires reserved capacity and a prewarm plan. Opening INF-4901 to track capacity commit and network policy for private deployments. Prewarm job prototype:
```
prewarm --model=smartserve --pool=staging --duration=2h
```

sam: Security: require threat model + dataflow before GA. If customer requires HSM/KMS, test adds ~10 business days. Also need clarify on logging/retention (PII rules) and whether pen-test needed for beta or only GA. :rotating_light:

fiona: I'll own rollout playbook & gating checklist. Creating doc: https://go.company/docs/smartserve-playbook. Please add owners, acceptance tests, and any external compliance steps.

maya: Owners so far: Raj runtime, Lin perf, Olga infra, Sam security, Fiona rollout. Raj, can you write minimal automated acceptance tests we can run in CI?

raj: Yep. Minimal CI checks (will add to repo):
- cold-start p95 <= 500ms (batch=1)
- token latency p95 <= 60ms at target throughput
- basic correctness (10 golden prompts -> expected outputs)
- end-to-end smoke (staging request -> response)
Example smoke curl:
```
curl -s -X POST https://staging.api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"model":"smartserve","input":"Test"}'
```
I'll open PR with tests by Thu EOD.

lin: I'll run perf across A100/Tr4 and attach CSV to the playbook. If quant is required, will bench 8-bit/4-bit. Also confirm memory/kv-cache footprints.

olga: INF-4901 created to track GA capacity + prewarm (link: https://go.company/tickets/INF-4901). Reserving staging pool and adding network egress task for private customers.

sam: Drafting threat model now. Product: do pilots include sample user data with any PII? If yes, we default to no-logs mode and stricter retention policies.

fiona: Maya, confirm data expectations and we'll add explicit PII sign-off step. I'll build rollout milestone timeline once owners populate the doc.

maya: Pilot customers will send tokenized queries, no raw PII. Compliance still needs HSM verification.

raj: Opening perf PR with smoke tests and runbook. PR ETA: Thu EOD.

olga: Also adding a prewarm cron job example to infra ticket. E.g., `0 3 * * * prewarm --model smartserve --duration 2h --pool ga` for nightly warm-up.

sam: If HSM required, will schedule integration window with infra. Also adding pen-test decision point in gating doc.

maya: Action items summary: everyone add owners/notes to https://go.company/docs/smartserve-playbook by EOD Friday; Raj -> CI smoke tests PR; Lin -> perf matrix Tue/Wed; Olga -> INF-4901 + reserve pools; Sam -> threat model + HSM plan; Fiona -> consolidate rollout checklist and publish timeline. Next sync: Friday 11:00am PT. :calendar:

deploy-bot: Ticket INF-4901 created by olga (https://go.company/tickets/INF-4901)

maya: Thanks all 1: If any blocker pops up, flag here so Fiona can rebaseline the timeline.
